title: Independent test of competing anodic oxidation pathways in diazo 1a
difficulty_reasons: The reactant is fixed, but locating and validating relevant first-order saddle points and distinguishing N2-loss from N2-retention oxidation requires conformer/pathway exploration and connectivity validation.

paper.title: Bromination Functionalization of Diazo Compounds with CBr4 via Convergent Paired Electrolysis

data.description: Self-contained neutral singlet SMILES for diethyl (diazo(phenyl)methyl)phosphonate (1a), the sole starting reactant.
